touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Trefriw qualifies as a local detour through Trefriw Woollen Mill and Parish Church of St. Mary. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Trefriw: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Trefriw offers Trefriw Woollen Mill, Parish Church of St. Mary, Peniel Welsh Presbyterian Chapel within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Trefriw Woollen Mill
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Trefriw Woollen Mill and Parish Church of St. Mary, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
